purpose: verify that API behavior matches its contract, including errors, security and compatibility, independently of any user interface
entry_criteria: API specification or documented contract exists
A test environment with the API is available
Test accounts for each role exist
procedure: Derive tests from the contract: every operation, status code, schema and error format.
Test authentication and authorization with each role and with no or expired credentials; check access to other users' objects.
Test input validation with missing, malformed, oversized and boundary values.
Check idempotency, pagination, rate limiting and backward compatibility against the previous version.
Run the tests in CI against a clean environment and record results.
Report contract differences to the API owner as defects in code or specification.
acceptance_criteria: Every operation has success and failure tests
Authorization is tested for each role and for other users' objects
Compatibility with the previous version is checked
Suite passes from a clean environment in CI

validation.command: schemathesis run openapi.yaml --base-url https://staging.example.com --checks all   # example contract fuzzer

failure_modes.detection: No test with another user's id

failure_modes.response: Fix the contract or the code

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Tests call each operation with each role. A user reading another user's order id receives 403 as the contract says; an oversized body returns 413; the previous version's fields remain present.
